chunks: It leaves nothing, nor does it spare;
ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'la tubqi wa la tadhur' mean regarding divine destruction?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir is often interpreted as describing the comprehensive nature of divine retribution or the consuming force of Hellfire, emphasizing total annihilation without exception. It underscores the absolute power of Allah to eradicate all remnants of disbelief, serving as a vivid metaphor for the inevitability of the Hereafter's judgment.
